name: authoring-as-the-user
description: Set the standard for any text that ships under the user's name — PR/MR descriptions and review comments, commit messages, tickets, docs, messages to colleagues. Every sentence must read as the assignee's own judgement, so a hedge that a tool call could settle is unfinished work, not a caveat: verify what is reachable, report it in measurements, and name only the specific residue that stayed out of reach.
